title: A Quote for the Shared Kitchen

scenes.setup: 陳主管請你替 Ortiz 女士的共用外送廚房找麵包供應商。
scenes.text: Ms. Ortiz needs bread for a pilot kitchen that fills orders for several restaurants. Please list Green Street Bakery as an ____ supplier because it operates without a parent company.

rescue.reaction: The bakery owner runs the business without direction from a larger company.

scenes.setup: 麵包和紙箱的價格都已確認，Ben 打來補問包裝成本。
scenes.text: Can you find out how many hours our packing team will need each week? I have the price of the boxes, and I need to add the labor cost to the quote.
scenes.question: Ben 請你確認哪項資訊？
options: 包裝人員每週需要多少工時
scenes.answer: 包裝人員每週需要多少工時

rescue.reaction: I need to know how much time the team will spend putting the orders into boxes.
options: 包裝人員每週需要多少工時
rescue.answer: 包裝人員每週需要多少工時

scenes.setup: Linda 算完人工成本，準備寄出試營運的報價。
scenes.text: The first order will be small, but the pilot has the ____ to bring in repeat orders if customers like the new menu.

rescue.reaction: If people enjoy the menu, they may come back and order it again.

scenes.setup: Ortiz 女士看過報價後打來確認第一批麵包的到貨時間。
scenes.text: The quote works for us. Can you move the first delivery from Thursday to Friday so our chef can be there?
scenes.question: Ortiz 女士希望怎麼調整？
options: 把報價有效期延到週五
把首次送貨提前到週四

rescue.reaction: Our chef can only be at the kitchen to receive the bread the day after Thursday.
options: 把首次送貨提前到週四

ending: 你重新確認送貨日期，讓廚師週五能親自驗收第一批麵包。

news.headline: Is Wonder the dinner company for our anti-social times?
news.summary: Wonder 以共用廚房製作不同品牌的餐點，讓顧客在同一筆訂單裡選擇多種料理。這種做法讓餐飲業者有機會用較低的場地和人事成本試推新品牌，也引發外界對餐飲標準化和社區餐廳逐漸失去特色的擔憂。

title: Racks for the Training Lab

scenes.setup: 陳主管請你安排一批機架，供資料中心的短期職訓課程使用。
scenes.text: The college will provide the classroom, and Brightline will teach the course using our equipment. Please list Brightline as our training ____ in the project brief.

rescue.reaction: We supply the racks and they teach the class, so both teams are helping run the course.

scenes.setup: Raj 打來安排上課前的機架檢查。
scenes.text: We need someone qualified to check the training racks before the class starts. Can you ask Brightline which of its technicians is approved to do that work?
scenes.question: Raj 請你向 Brightline 確認什麼？
options: 哪位講師負責第一堂課
哪位技師具備檢查機架的資格
哪位學員可以協助收貨
scenes.answer: 哪位技師具備檢查機架的資格

rescue.reaction: Anyone can help with the boxes, but checking the racks takes specific training.
options: 哪位技師具備檢查機架的資格
哪位學員可以協助收貨
rescue.answer: 哪位技師具備檢查機架的資格

scenes.setup: Brightline 確認技師人選後，Linda 請你更新開課文件。
scenes.text: Please update the ____ to show the rack check on Tuesday and the first class on Wednesday.

rescue.reaction: Both teams need to know which day each activity will take place.

scenes.setup: 機架預計週一送達，Ortiz 女士打來交代收貨地點。
scenes.text: The training room will be locked on Monday morning. Could you ask the carrier to leave the racks at the receiving desk?
scenes.question: Ortiz 女士希望司機把貨送到哪裡？

rescue.reaction: The person who signs for deliveries will be at the desk by the loading entrance.

ending: 你安排週一在收貨處簽收機架，技師週二完成檢查，課程順利在週三開始。

news.headline: $100,000 pay, very little training: The data center jobs no one knows about
news.summary: 美國大量興建 AI 資料中心，但能安裝光纖、電力和冷卻設備的技術人員不足，有些工程因此延後。科技公司與培訓機構推出免費或帶薪的短期實作課程，幫助轉職者更快上工，部分職缺加上加班費後年收入可達六位數美元。

title: Before We Hit Send

scenes.setup: Raj 轉寄 Anthropic 的文章，請你先替 AI 回信工具設計幾個測試案例。
scenes.text: I'm forwarding an article from Anthropic about testing AI before rollout. Let's make our test ____ by using the kinds of order changes we handled last week.

rescue.reaction: Think about the emails we actually get, like a customer asking for a new delivery date.

scenes.setup: 工具已經寫好測試回信，Ben 打來討論怎麼評分。
scenes.text: To measure how often the tool gives the right delivery date, can you check each draft against the order sheet? I'd like a count of the dates it got right.
scenes.question: Ben 希望你統計什麼？
options: 需要改送貨地址的訂單數
還沒收到回覆的訂單數
交貨日期寫對的草稿數
scenes.answer: 交貨日期寫對的草稿數

rescue.reaction: Compare the date in each draft with the one on the order sheet and mark every match.
options: 需要改送貨地址的訂單數
交貨日期寫對的草稿數
rescue.answer: 交貨日期寫對的草稿數

scenes.setup: Raj 看過分數後，想知道草稿是否還有其他問題。
scenes.text: Please send me your ____ on the drafts. I'd like to know which ones promise a date the warehouse hasn't confirmed.

rescue.reaction: Tell me where the replies could confuse a customer, even if the date itself is right.

scenes.setup: 陳主管看過測試結果，打電話和你確認試用安排。
scenes.text: I can approve a small trial for Friday's orders. Could you ask Ben to check every reply before it goes to a customer?
scenes.question: 陳主管希望 Ben 負責什麼？
options: 通知客戶週五會試用新工具
在回信寄出前逐封檢查
整理週五訂單的配送順序
scenes.answer: 在回信寄出前逐封檢查

rescue.reaction: Someone needs to read each draft before anyone presses Send. Is Ben free to do that?
options: 在回信寄出前逐封檢查
整理週五訂單的配送順序
rescue.answer: 在回信寄出前逐封檢查

ending: 週五試用時，Ben 在寄出前抓到一封把預計交貨日寫成已確認日期的回信，你們修正後才寄給客戶。

news.headline: Building strong safety evaluations
news.summary: Anthropic 建議先釐清 AI 上線後可能造成哪些問題，再用貼近實際的情境測試，訂出明確的評分規則並請人抽查評分結果。公司可以先拿常見的交貨變更來試寫回信，逐封核對日期和承諾，再決定是否開放試用。
